about_the_game:
No rest for the wicked...

Hunted through time and reality, Lady Death must slash and burn her way through horrific hordes while unravelling a sinister mystery. It will take every ounce of her courage, cunning and dark sorcery just to survive.

For in the end, Lady Death must face her most fearsome, most malicious, most lethal adversary yet.

Lady Death Demonicron is an all new side-scrolling, sword-slicing, magic-wielding, 15 level co-op hack and slash that takes the best aspects of the 1990s arcade classics all mixed together with a killer industrial-metal soundtrack.

If you’ve ever wondered what the love child of Mortal Kombat and Golden Axe would look like, we give you Demonicron.
requirements_minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GT or AMD HD 3870 512MB
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5+
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 or Radeon HD 5750 or better
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
